shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md; printf '\\n--- test commands ---\\n'; sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml; printf '\\n--- status ---\\n'; git status --short --branch"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts; printf '\\n--- spec ---\\n'; sed -n '1,240p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md; printf '\\n--- recent commits ---\\n'; git log --oneline -5"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then echo '__REANCHOR_EXISTS__'; sed -n '1,220p' scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; else echo '__NO_REANCHOR__'; fi; rg -n \"onErrorNonError|validated by\" specs src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts | head -40"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n '\"prettier|\"spec:names' package.json; git diff --check; git diff -- specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check; git status --short; git add specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git commit -m "chore(spec): fix rejection hook trace links"'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short --branch; git rev-parse HEAD; git rev-parse @{u}'
